observations.send_receive_dispatch: 0B sends,0C sends then receives,0D receives. Send callsA16CC8 or zero-lengthA16CA8. Receive callsA170DC and writes returned length to shared+14; metadata lives+16 and payload+1E.
observations.normal_copyback: ScanBBC408 copies26-byte shared header back on zero SendMessage result, allocates/copies shared payload length, returns zero-extended16 length; BB0614 copies data/metadata and returns it.
observations.hapi_exception: Recognized typed exception stores raw exception+18 into message result+0C atA54A4D; unrecognized exception stores0x2D atA54AF4.
observations.scan_exception: Nonzero SendMessage result invokesAF55A4. AF5510 preserves raw supplied status at exception+18. BB06F8 sets callback return-1 and, when status pointer exists, copies exception+18 into it.
observations.receive_guard: Hapi checks0152 header, rejects payload length>0xC000 via status0x108, retries invalid frame candidates up to50 before status0x26, and raises0x104 on checksum mismatch. Checksum computation algorithm not resolved here.
observations.vm_boundary: VM406FC0 tests signed low16 callback result; positive lengths copy min(result,B0 capacity) but full length is written separately. Nonpositive path consults separate error status; normal callback path has no explicit write to that out pointer in this window.
